description: Invoice number (6 digits). Per UCI: a code starting with 'C' indicates a cancellation. Workbook header may read Invoice or InvoiceNo.
Product (item) code; 5-digit integral number per distinct product per UCI. Non-product codes (e.g. postage) also occur and are classified by this project.
Product name.
Quantity of each product per transaction line. Negative values occur (cancellations and other adjustments).
Date and time the transaction was generated.
Product price per unit in pounds sterling (GBP). Workbook header may read Price or UnitPrice.
Customer number (5-digit). Pseudonymous identifier; missing for many lines. Workbook header may read 'Customer ID'.
Name of the country where the customer resides.
Name of the workbook sheet the row came from.
Excel row number in the source sheet (header = row 1).

SALE | CANCELLATION | ADJUSTMENT | STOCK_ADJUSTMENT | ZERO_PRICE | OTHER_ANOMALY. First matching rule: invoice starts C -> CANCELLATION; starts A -> ADJUSTMENT; price<0 -> OTHER_ANOMALY; quantity<=0 -> STOCK_ADJUSTMENT; price=0 -> ZERO_PRICE; else SALE.
PRODUCT if StockCode matches 5 digits + up to 2 letters (after UPPER/TRIM); otherwise NON_PRODUCT (postage/fees/manual etc.). Heuristic - review reports.
Quantity x UnitPrice in GBP. Negative for cancellations.
True for the 2nd+ occurrence of an identical line (all 8 source fields) inside one sheet. Retained; may be genuine.
yyyy-mm of InvoiceDate (added when loaded by the app / DimDate in SQL).
Most frequent non-null description for the StockCode.
Number of distinct descriptions seen for the StockCode.
Earliest and latest invoice timestamp for the CustomerID.
Surrogate key for Country.

description: Calendar attributes for each date in the data range.
Data-quality findings on the typed raw data. Severity ERROR blocks processing; WARNING and INFO are reported.
Every transformation applied and the number of rows affected.
Rows that could not be interpreted (unparseable date/quantity/price or missing invoice/stockcode). Never silently dropped.
